title: The light switch: the 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine

questions.prompt: How much faster than a human eye does the alga react to light?
feedback: Not quite: the Nobel Committee says it is more than twenty times faster.
Closer, but the Nobel Committee says more than twenty times faster.
Yes. The Nobel Committee says: more than twenty times faster, about half a millisecond after light reaches its eyespot.

questions.prompt: In our toy model, which colour of light reaches deepest into brain tissue?
feedback: Blue fades fastest in our toy model.
Yellow goes further than blue, but not furthest.
Red, in our toy model. It ignores absorption outside blood, so read every depth as rough.

questions.prompt: In our toy model, how many neurons can one degree of warming recruit with blue light?
feedback: Far more, in our toy model.
More than that, in our toy model.
More than ten thousand, in our toy model with its assumptions: one threshold, one expression law.
